Perfect! After Nxf2+ (forcing check) followed by Qxa1, Black has won both White rooks and is up about 10 points of material—a completely winning position.

**Best move:** Nxf2+

**Main line:** Nxf2+ Kg1 (or Kg2) Qxa1+ and Black is up two rooks.

**Motif:** fork

**Coaching note:**

---

Your knight on h3 and queen on d4 both attack the rook on f2. By playing **Nxf2+** with check, you force the king to move, then capture the undefended rook on a1 with your queen—winning both rooks. The key insight: a checking move often wins material because the opponent must respond to the check first. Always look for forcing moves (checks, captures with threats) when loose enemy pieces exist.
